items.title: Threat Actors Gaining Access to Victims’ Machines and Monetizing Access to Their Bandwidth

Attackers exploited JXPath query injection within Apache Commons libraries, allowing arbitrary code execution through crafted XML requests. items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have observed a surge in phishing campaigns leveraging QR codes to deliver malicious payloads. This emerging threat, often dubbed “quishing,” exploits the opaque nature of QR codes to conceal harmful URLs that redirect victims to credential-harvesting sites or malware downloads.
